hooks.command: echo 'command-advisor plugin: when a workflow moment comes up (build or type check fails, code was just written, tests are missing, about to commit, open a PR or deploy, a new feature is requested, a tricky bug was solved), invoke the Skill command-advisor:command-advisor FIRST, before investigating or answering. It offers a matching installed command through a question card and runs nothing without the user saying yes. Skip it for quick questions and one-line edits.'
